name: melodia_production_lanes
purpose: Real game work routed to local models. Every task produces an artifact the project actually needs, and acceptance is a contract check -- not a score. Replaces the synthetic MATH benchmark tasks as the measure of whether a local model is useful here.

doctrine.the_ai_is_a_tool: These lanes exist to produce game artifacts. A lane that scores well and ships nothing has failed.
doctrine.acceptance_not_score: A task is ACCEPTED when its artifact passes the named contract check. There is no partial credit and no percentage.
doctrine.no_self_certification: No lane records its own ledger row. Acceptance produces an artifact; a human or a gate script runs `Tools/echo_run.py record <gate> pass|fail`.
doctrine.local_first: Production lanes are local-only (see LOCAL_ONLY_CLASSES in Tools/model_router.py). Content generation must not require network or incur cloud spend.
doctrine.schema_is_shown: Every task hands the model the exact contract it will be judged against. Scoring a model on a schema it was never shown is a harness defect, not a model finding -- see the 2026-08-19 regression documented in Tools/run_math_models.py::_format_schema.

tasks.description: Emit one wardrobe cosmetic record for the Melusina V2 outfit.
tasks.artifact: a single JSON object conforming to first_outfit.records[] in specs/wardrobe/wardrobe_catalog_source.v1.json
tasks.accepted_when: The object validates against the record schema: cosmetic_id matches ^Cos_[A-Za-z0-9_]+$, slot is one of the five declared slots, rarity is Common, mesh matches the V2 outfit path pattern, resonant_form_id is null.
tasks.must_not: Invent a slot outside the enum, or emit a mesh path outside /Game/Melodia/Characters/Melusina/Outfits/V2/.

tasks.description: Author a QuillScript notification granting a social stat for a named story intent.
tasks.artifact: a notification string in the seven-verb contract
tasks.accepted_when: melodia_quill_validate_notification returns is_valid_verb true, the verb is one of battle|quest|flag|travel|reward|stat|item, and the intent id is well formed.
tasks.must_not: Emit an id that is not in the allowlist, or a verb outside the seven.
tasks.note: This is also the exact shape the music_world_key seam needs: APCGHeroMusicGraphHost::OnPatternCompleted must emit one of these into UMelodiaNarrativeSubsystem.

tasks.description: Author the notification that a completed Piano pattern should emit -- the music-as-key consequence.
tasks.artifact: a flag or quest notification string in the seven-verb contract
tasks.accepted_when: Validates as a flag: or quest: verb. Must NOT be a battle: verb -- music opens doors, it never enters the combat or damage pipeline (see PCGHeroMusic.cpp:624).
tasks.must_not: Emit a battle: verb. That would make music a second combat authority.

tasks.description: Read the rhythm skill catalog and report the grade multiplier curve and song pairings.
tasks.artifact: a structured summary of the live rhythm skill definitions
tasks.accepted_when: Every skill id reported exists in the tool response. Zero invented skill ids.
tasks.must_not: Make rhythm a second combat authority, or invent a skill id.

tasks.description: Cross-check the Melusina ABP state machine and pose bindings against the Monolith reading.
tasks.artifact: a diff between the model's reading and melodia_animation_validate_state_machine
tasks.accepted_when: The model's findings agree with the tool response, or any disagreement is a real, reproducible finding.
tasks.must_not: Write a .uasset. This lane is read-only.
tasks.note: Two independent readings of the same asset is the point -- disagreement is a finding, not noise.

tasks.description: Triage the current static_gates failure: two verify_baseline material drifts.
tasks.artifact: a triage note naming each drifted asset, its node delta, and a recommended action (re-baseline vs revert)
tasks.context: static_gates FAIL 2026-08-14: M_Master_Simple_Universal 32305->33784 bytes 25->26 nodes; M_Master_Toon_Landscape_HeightBlend 427468->450364 bytes 290->304 nodes. The other four sub-gates passed.
tasks.accepted_when: Every file path named in the output exists on disk. Zero fabricated paths.
tasks.must_not: Fabricate a file path. This is the single most common failure mode for this lane.
